questions.title: Whom will Donald Trump endorse in the 2026 Republican primary for Tennessee's Ninth Congressional District?
questions.resolution_criteria:
• Source of Truth: as established by Trump's public statements or contemporaneous news reporting.
  • Resolution Date: ahead of the August 6, 2026 primary.
  • Accepted Answer Format: Answer with the candidate's first and last name.
questions.accepted_format: Answer with the candidate's first and last name.

questions.title: Who will win the Democratic nomination for U.S. Senate in Kansas in 2026?
questions.background: Kansas will hold a U.S. Senate election in November 2026, with party nominees selected in the August primary.
questions.resolution_criteria:
• Source of Truth: Results reported by Kansas election authorities or definitive election reporting from a major news organization.
  • Resolution: Resolve to the winner of Kansas's Democratic U.S. Senate primary scheduled for August 4, 2026, once the outcome is unambiguously reported.
  • Accepted Answer Format: The winning candidate's full name.

questions.title: Who will win Michigan’s 2026 Democratic primary for U.S. Senate?
questions.background: Michigan will elect a U.S. senator in November 2026. The Democratic primary will determine the party’s nominee for that election.
questions.resolution_criteria:
• Source of Truth: Results from Michigan election authorities or unambiguous reporting by major news organizations identifying the winner of Michigan’s 2026 Democratic primary for U.S. Senate.
  • Resolution Date: Resolve when the winner of the primary, scheduled for August 4, 2026, is publicly established.
  • Accepted Answer Format: The winning candidate’s name.

questions.title: Who will win the 2026 Republican primary for Tennessee’s 5th Congressional District?
questions.background: Andy Ogles has represented Tennessee’s 5th Congressional District in the U.S. House of Representatives since 2023.
questions.resolution_criteria:
• Source of Truth: Official Tennessee election results, with a definitive Associated Press race call accepted before certification.
  • Resolution Event: The determination of the winner of the Republican primary for Tennessee’s 5th Congressional District scheduled for August 6, 2026.
  • Accepted Answer Format: The winning candidate’s full name.

questions.title: Who will win the Republican primary for Alabama's 2nd Congressional District on August 11, 2026?
questions.background: The primary will determine the Republican nominee for this U.S. House seat in the November 2026 general election.
questions.resolution_criteria:
• Source of Truth: The Associated Press's results and reporting for Alabama's August 11, 2026 Republican primary in the 2nd Congressional District.
  • Resolution: Resolve when AP identifies the candidate who has secured the nomination. A preliminary lead or advancement to a runoff does not count as winning the nomination.
  • Accepted Answer Format: The winning candidate's full name.

questions.title: Who will win the 2026 Republican U.S. House primary featuring Florida incumbent Cory Mills?
questions.background: Cory Mills is seeking a third term in the U.S. House of Representatives.
questions.resolution_criteria:
• Source of Truth: Florida Division of Elections results or contemporaneous reporting by established news organizations identifying the primary winner.
  • Resolution: Resolve to the winner of the Florida Republican U.S. House primary in which Cory Mills is a candidate, scheduled for August 18, 2026.
  • Accepted Answer Format: The winning candidate's full name.

questions.title: Who will win Florida's 2026 Democratic primary for the U.S. Senate special election?
questions.background: Florida is holding a special election to complete the U.S. Senate term vacated by Marco Rubio after he became secretary of state.
questions.resolution_criteria:
• Source of Truth: Florida Division of Elections results or contemporaneous reporting by established news organizations identifying the primary winner.
  • Resolution: Resolve to the winner of Florida's Democratic primary for the U.S. Senate special election, scheduled for August 18, 2026.
  • Accepted Answer Format: The winning candidate's full name.

questions.title: Who will President Donald Trump nominate in 2026 to succeed Marty Makary as FDA commissioner?
questions.background: Marty Makary resigned as commissioner of the US Food and Drug Administration in May 2026, leaving the position vacant. The president nominates the commissioner, subject to Senate confirmation.
questions.resolution_criteria:
• Source of Truth: An official presidential announcement or reliable news reporting directly quoting that announcement.
  • Resolution Conditions: Resolve to the first person President Trump publicly announces as his nominee for FDA commissioner after Makary’s May 2026 resignation and before the end of 2026. The nomination announcement is sufficient; Senate confirmation is not required.
  • Accepted Answer Format: The nominee’s full name.

questions.title: Who will win the 2026 special election for California's 14th congressional district?
questions.background: A special election will fill the U.S. House vacancy created by Eric Swalwell's resignation in April 2026.
questions.resolution_criteria:
• Source of Truth: Consistent winner projections reported by major U.S. news organizations based on special-election results.
  • Resolution Event: Resolve when a winner is publicly projected for the special election to complete Swalwell's unexpired term. The November 2026 election for the following full term does not count.
  • Accepted Answer Format: The winning candidate's full name.

questions.title: Which Republican U.S. Senate candidate will be reported by August 25, 2026, to have asked AIPAC not to campaign on their behalf?
questions.background: The American Israel Public Affairs Committee (AIPAC) is a pro-Israel lobbying organization active in congressional elections. Its political support has historically extended to candidates from both major U.S. parties. The next midterm elections are scheduled for November 2026.
questions.resolution_criteria:
• Source of Truth: Reporting by established news organizations published by August 25, 2026.
  • Resolution Conditions: Identify the Republican candidate for U.S. Senate in the November 2026 election reported to have requested that AIPAC not run a campaign on their behalf. A request conveyed through the candidate's campaign allies qualifies; merely criticizing AIPAC does not.
  • Accepted Answer Format: The candidate's first and last name.
questions.accepted_format: The candidate's first and last name.

questions.title: Which state will MAGA Inc. target with its first major general-election advertising buy of the 2026 midterms?
questions.background: MAGA Inc. is a super PAC associated with Donald Trump. Its advertising commitments can indicate which congressional races Republicans consider strategically important.
questions.resolution_criteria:
• Source of Truth: MAGA Inc.'s public announcement and corresponding Federal Election Commission filing, corroborated by contemporaneous reporting.
  • Resolution Rule: Resolve to the state targeted by the advertising commitment identified as MAGA Inc.'s first major general-election advertising expenditure of the 2026 midterm cycle. Resolution occurs when the commitment is publicly announced, regardless of when the advertisements begin running.
  • Accepted Answer Format: The name of the U.S. state where the advertisements are scheduled to run.
questions.accepted_format: The name of the U.S. state where the advertisements are scheduled to run.

questions.title: Which Republican U.S. senator will formally request that the Senate Judiciary Committee investigate Donald Trump Jr.’s foreign business dealings in September 2026?
questions.background: Donald Trump Jr. is President Donald Trump’s eldest son. Congressional investigations can examine potential conflicts of interest involving a president’s family members.
questions.resolution_criteria:
• Source of Truth: Public congressional correspondence or reliable contemporaneous news reporting identifying the senator making the request.
  • Qualifying Event: A Republican U.S. senator formally requests during September 2026 that the Senate Judiciary Committee investigate Donald Trump Jr.’s foreign business relationships.
  • Accepted Answer Format: The senator’s full name.
